segments.name: oil and gas operations
segments.description: Develops and produces oil and natural gas from Permian Basin properties in New Mexico, sold to purchasers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable operating segment, its oil and gas operations which derives its revenue from the sale of oil and gas products.

revenueModel.text: Crude oil and natural gas purchasers pay the company for oil and gas production from its Permian Basin properties.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable consist of receivables from crude oil and natural gas purchasers and are generally uncollateralized.
